dedupe_keys.name: tia 942 certified data centre listing and standard overview

description: The TIA-942 certification page describes the programme that reviews and certifies data centres against the ANSI/TIA-942 standard and points to a worldwide listing of certified sites. Contents: the standard's scope (telecommunications infrastructure of data centres and computer rooms, covering site location, architecture, electrical, mechanical, safety and security), the Design, Facilities and Readiness certifications each with four classification rating levels, a search of certified data centres and a search of licensed auditors and consultants. Producer: TIA, which publishes the standard and runs the programme. Coverage: certified facilities worldwide, not a full inventory of data centres. Access: a public web page with two search tools; no bulk download was seen. Licence and cost: the listing is free to search; no reuse licence is stated, and the standard itself is a purchased document. Caveats: only sites that paid for certification appear, ratings describe design and facility redundancy, not measured uptime, and the searchable entries were not read for this record. Simulation uses: the rating levels give redundancy classes for data centre resilience and capacity models, and the listing identifies rated critical facilities. Related record: the Cloudscene data centre directory (data-cloudscene-data-centre-directory).
